rule_text.name: 701.86a
rule_text.rule: To reappropriate, exile exactly two cards from your hand and/or graveyard.

rule_text.name: 701.86b
rule_text.rule: If you are instructed to reappropriate while your hand and graveyard have only one card total, you will be unable to. Any abilities that would trigger due to that reappropriate action don't.

representative_cards.name: Creed's Desperado
representative_cards.original_text:
Mana cost: {2}{R}
Type: Creature — Spirit Warrior
Power/Toughness: 3/2
Bloodprice—Reappropriate red. *(You may cast this spell by sacrificing a creature and exiling two red cards from your hand and/or graveyard.)*
Haste
Whenever Creed's Desperado attacks, if defending player has more cards in hand than you, exile the top card of that player's library. You may cast it as long as you control a Warrior, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it.
